title: Raye leads the 2027 Grammy nominations with 11, and Beyoncé reaches 100 career nominations
dek: The Recording Academy announced the 69th Grammys field on Monday. Posts from fans and artists spread the lists within minutes, and one DJ said the dance category is not for dance music.
what: The Recording Academy announced the nominations for the 2027 Grammy Awards on Monday, 16 November 2026. The ceremony is on Sunday, 7 February 2027, at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles. It airs live on ABC and streams on Disney+ and Hulu. The Grammys' own account posted the Best Global Music Album nominees: Anitta, Davido, Angelique Kidjo, Ayra Starr and Tems.

Grammy.com lists the Album of the Year nominees as Phoebe Bridgers, Olivia Dean, Ella Langley, Bruno Mars, RAYE, Olivia Rodrigo, ROSALÍA and Taylor Swift. Its Record of the Year list has eight entries, including "Berghain" by ROSALÍA, Björk and Yves Tumor and "Dracula" by Tame Impala and JENNIE.

Yahoo reports that RAYE leads with 11 nominations, tying the record for a woman. It reports ROSALÍA has nine, and Ella Langley, Miranda Lambert, Olivia Rodrigo and Phoebe Bridgers seven each. Yahoo also reports that Beyoncé became the first artist to receive 100 Grammy nominations. Grammy.com lists her "MORNING DEW (DONK)" in Best R&B Solo Performance. I did not count her career total myself.

Five categories are new, among them Best Asian Pop Music Performance. Its nominees, as posted by Chart Data, are BABYMETAL with Polyphia, BINI, IVE, KiiiKiii, LiSA and SB19. Yahoo says BTS withdrew its music from consideration. A separate post says BTS is the first K-pop act nominated for a Grammy. I could not reconcile the two and did not check either.

Reactions came fast. Tinashe posted that she has her first nominations, two of them. The DJ John Summit posted that he will not submit to the Grammys again and that the dance category is dominated by pop stars. Those are their own views.
why: Nominations land at one moment, so fans of every genre post their own corner of the list at once, and each group reads the same list through its own category.
